parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: This is the cover of a trash can, made of polypropylene plastic. It is circular and fits snugly on top of the container.
parts.Functional_description: The cover prevents odors from escaping and keeps the contents concealed. It may include a swing or flip mechanism for easy disposal.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or swing open when pressed, and return to its closed position automatically or manually.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main container body of the trash can, made of polypropylene plastic. It is cylindrical and designed to hold waste.
parts.Functional_description: The container stores the trash and supports the cover. It may hold a removable liner or bag for easy cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or carried when emptying or cleaning.
